sourceFacts.evidence: DENSO describes suction control valves and variants for pump systems; generic SCV terminology alone does not prove compatibility.
Bosch describes unit injector as a pump integrated with nozzle and solenoid; unit pump and common-rail families must not be merged as equivalent products.
Delphi directs checking the correct injector part number and noting the correction code.
DENSO warns high-pressure fuel leaks can cause severe injury; relevant buyer education may stay but must avoid unsafe home diagnostic procedures.
sourceFacts.editorialBoundary: Symptoms do not prove a failed part. Ask qualified diesel service for diagnosis; do not instruct users to loosen operating high-pressure lines or find leaks by touch.
